thread:
alex: rolling out canary 2026-03-15T14:10Z -> image=redwood/inference:v3.4.1 canary=10% starting now. pinging oncall in case of anything odd.

incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: SEV2 - canary_error_rate > 5% for service inference-runtime-canary (alert_id: canary_error_rate). Paging oncall.

dev-deploy-bot: rollout id=rl-2026-0315-7 started, target=svc/inference, canaryPct=10, commit=aa12b3c

sasha: saw the pager. jumping in. trying to pull the canary dashboard but most panels are empty for this cluster (us-west-2-canary). looks like the grafana datasource is misconfigured for the new metric name.

kevin: can confirm alert payload doesn't include a runbook link. looks like alert rule was copied from old stack and the annotations.job_runbook variable is blank.

maria: quick customer note - Support banner: two customers reported timeouts in prod at ~14:12. unsure if canary only or full.

alex: i can take initial triage. can someone post the raw alert details?

incident-bot: Alert details:
- name: canary_error_rate
- fired_at: 2026-03-15T14:12:03Z
- expr: sum(rate(request_errors_total{deploy="canary"}[1m])) / sum(rate(request_total{deploy="canary"}[1m])) > 0.05
- labels: env=canary, region=us-west-2
- annotations: summary="Canary error rate >5%"

kevin: looking at the rule now. who updated it? it references metric "request_errors_total" but our runtime emits "request_errors_total_v2" after the agent change last week. that mismatch could explain empty dashboard panels but alert firing because rule is using a fallback metric. messy.

sasha: also dashboards use aggregation 'sum' across pods. for canaries we want rate per-second normalized by pod_count. noisy with low traffic. we should throttle alert to only >5% for 1m AND min_requests>50.

maria: we need a mitigation path now. options: 1) flip canary off (feature flag kill-switch) 2) rollback rollout to previous image 3) silence alerting while we patch dashboards. which is fastest?

alex: i'll attempt feature flag first (least blast radius). if that doesn't stop errors we rollback. handing to @kevin to do flag and @maria to monitor customer impact. i'm going to mute my calendar.

kevin: toggling flag "ff_canary_v3" -> OFF for 10% group now. command: 
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $FF_API_TOKEN" \
  https://flags.redwood/api/v1/flags/ff_canary_v3/targets \
  -d '{"remove": [{"segment":"canary-10pct"}] }'
```
kevin: flag change propagated. should take ~10s.

dev-deploy-bot: Feature flag update detected for ff_canary_v3, change_id=chg-8821, affected=svc/inference(canary).

maria: confirmed traffic to canary pods dropped ~95% within 30s. customer timeouts still being reported for a minute after, likely requests in-flight. severity trending down.

alex: good. can we avoid a full rollback for now? i'd prefer to let running requests drain and watch SLOs for 10-15m.

sasha: SLO dashboard is still blank for this canary slice. i've spun up a quick one-off grafana panel using the raw metric v2 and rate per pod: https://grafana.redwood/d/quick/canary-live?panel=1 (temp). it shows a spike and then decay after the flag flip.

kevin: still seeing a bunch of noisy canary_error_rate alerts from different groups (some use old metric names). i'm going to silence the specific alert rule for canary_error_rate in alertmanager for 20m to stop paging while we stabilize.

kevin: alertmanager silence created: silence_id=sl-4492, duration=20m, creator=kevin. note: this stops pages but does not fix root cause.

incident-bot: Silence applied to alerts with label is=canary_error_rate by kevin (20m)

maria: customers reporting latency returning to normal. i'm tracking two support tickets and updated them with "mitigated: feature flag toggled, monitoring ongoing".

alex: ok handoff: @maria you're primary follow-up owner for next hour to verify no regressions. i'll add a follow-up action list. @kevin please open a PR to fix alert runbook and rule to reference the right metric and min_requests threshold. @sasha please update dashboards to use v2 metrics and add canary-specific panels.

kevin: creating issue and PR: github.com/redwood/infra/alerts#234 - will include runbook link and fix expr to use request_errors_total_v2 and add min_requests>50.

sasha: created temp dashboard panels and added to team dash collection. will make them permanent after PR review.

alex: nice work. postmortem owners: kevin (alerts), sasha (dashboards), maria (customer comms). i'll draft the timeline and publish in #incidents with links to tickets.

maria: quick note for handoff - i'll monitor for 30m then escalate back if new pages. leaving a marker in oncall calendar at 14:50. :thumbsup:

kevin: rollback not needed, rollout remains paused. will only rollback if error rate reappears after flag and silence expire.

incident-bot: Incident resolved (mitigated) - Status: mitigated by feature_flag_toggle and alert silencing. recorded by incident-bot at 2026-03-15T14:37:05Z.

alex: thank you everyone. action items assigned, will follow up with a short postmortem and runbook links.

sasha: adding runbook checklist item: make sure new metrics are added to alert templates before rolling agents in future.

kevin: noted. will add automation to ci to validate alert metric names against exported metrics during deploys.

maria: closing ticket updates, will reopen if we see further customer impact.

alex: end of thread.
